meta.description: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay — one of India's premier engineering institutes.

description: India's top-ranked engineering institute (NIRF #3 overall). Offers B.Tech, B.S., M.Tech, M.Sc., MBA, and Ph.D. programs. Uses IIT 10-point grading (AA/AB/BB/BC/CC/CD/DD/FR) with SPI/CPI system. Semester system with Autumn (Jul-Nov) and Spring (Jan-Apr) terms.

academic_calendar.details: Autumn semester: Jul-Nov, Spring semester: Jan-Apr. Summer term: May-Jun for internships/projects.

available.name: IIT Bombay Standard Pattern
available.description: 10-point letter grade system (AA/AB/BB/BC/CC/CD/DD/FR). SPI per semester, CPI cumulative. Min DD to pass. 40% IA + 60% ESE typical.
